srk_mainParagraph: Developing, upgrading, and transferring your employees' competencies into everyday business practice is an important strategic objective. Delays in developing employee competencies carry a significant risk of permanent non-competitiveness.
srk_quoteParagraph: An organization's fundamental value is the potential of its employees.
srk_card1Heading: The basis for most HR processes
srk_card1Text: The majority of HR processes are built on competency models. They serve as the foundation for recruitment, performance appraisal, compensation, succession planning, and employee development. Additionally, the competency model serves as a basis for the 360-degree competency assessment.
srk_card2Text: Companies must constantly innovate in order to be successful. This increases the need for additional knowledge and skills from employees. On the other hand, it enhances the employee experience.
srk_card3Text: Demands from customers and markets are expanding at an unprecedented rate in today's business environment. In order to remain competitive, any organization must be able to adapt to a changing environment and have the knowledge and skills to do so.
srk_Plan1Card1: Developing a competency model that is completely in line with the strategy of the organization.
srk_Plan1Card2: A detailed DNLA analysis of the organization's competency gaps.
srk_Plan1Card3: We have a catalogue of competencies and business behaviours suited to particular job functions.
srk_Plan1Card4: We use an international database of competencies and recommendations for more than 700 business roles.
srk_Plan1Card5: The implementation of a 360-degree measurement process supported by technology.
srk_Plan1Card6: A competency development plan based on the analysis of development needs.
srk_Plan1Card7: Customized training and development based on the participants business roles.
srk_Plan1Card8: Combined programmes of personal development (coaching, workshops, and business training).
srk_Plan1Card9: Passing on knowledge to in-house mentors.
srk_Plan2Heading: The benefits of systematic competencies development
srk_Plan2Card1: Employees are aware of the competencies and skills they need to improve.
srk_Plan2Card2: HR can better identify the potential of candidates for different business roles.
srk_Plan2Card3: Training programs can concentrate solely on critical skills, reducing development costs.
srk_Plan2Card4: Staff induction and training are facilitated, and new leaders and successors are systematically developed.
srk_Plan2Card5: Employee productivity and innovation are increased as work errors are reduced.
srk_Plan2Card6: Employee retention improves as they see the value of investing in their careers.
srk_bigCard1Heading: Most HR processes are based on competency models
srk_bigCard1Content: Effective management and employee development are built on a modern competency model. Managing the key potential of employees in connection to the organization's strategy should be given particular consideration while designing it. All other HR processes revolve around it. Employee selection, performance management, talent management, and succession planning are among the areas it can be used.
srk_bigCard2Heading: Rapid change in today's corporate environment requires the development of effective competencies
srk_bigCard2Content: HR Development, in our opinion, entails more than just education, workshops, and training. All stakeholders in the corporate ecosystem are affected by this process, which is ongoing and has a direct impact on them. As a result, it should be addressed with caution, as it directly contributes to the creation of value for the organization, its customers, and other stakeholders. The unique characteristics of organizations, as well as their development requirements, often require the integration and combination of several approaches to employee training. All of this, however, should be based on proper development planning.
srk_bigCard3Content: The 360-degree feedback allows organizations to quickly receive feedback on staff performance and the development level of their business behaviour. 360-degree feedback evaluates an individual's performance in terms of key competencies for success. Based on the business strategy and the competency model relevant to the business of the clients, we personalize our solution to meet the individual needs of our clients. In addition, we provide high-quality IT assistance for the evaluation process.
srk_bigCard4Content: Effective 360-degree feedback goes beyond providing a 360-degree report on an individual's performance or providing a technical solution for performance monitoring. It is a process that begins with the organization's strategy and challenges and ends with the development of employees in ways that enable the business to implement its strategy effectively.
srk_article2CardHeading: DNLA sistem ponuja celovito strokovno podporo drugim kadrovskim procesom
srk_article2CardContent: Dober proces razvoja zaposlenih je pomemben dejavnik pri zadržanju naših sodelavcev (retention), vendar le ti želijo sodoben pristop razvoja njihovih veščin.
srk_article3CardHeading: Pet vprašanj za Alexandra Tychy-ja o razvoju potenciala z DNLA orodji
srk_article3CardContent: Rast! Produktivnost! Boljša sposobnost obvladovanja sprememb! Prilagajanje organizacije  na zahtevne pogoje današnjega časa!
srk_article1CardContent: V današnjem času se pogosto postavljajo vprašanja smiselnosti vzpostavitve notranjega usposabljanja. Notranji trenerji imajo lahko zelo učinkovito vlogo pri razvoju sodelavcev in pri uvajanju kulturoloških sprememb v organizacije.
mktvkp_heading: Most HR processes are based on competency models.
mktvkp_content: Competencies are the ability to apply the necessary knowledge and skills to complete a task successfully and efficiently. They include a person's knowledge, skills, and values. Competency models are organized frameworks for describing the relationship between competence and performance. Competency models are increasingly being used in recruitment, performance management, talent management, and succession planning. We use it as a basis for overall improvement of employee performance.
mktvkp_Plan1Heading: The key benefits of using the competency model are:
mktvkp_PlanCard1: It helps employees perform in accordance with the goals and strategies of the organization.
mktvkp_PlanCard2: It serves as a foundation for evaluating employee performance objectively and identifying growth opportunities.
mktvkp_PlanCard3: A simplified recruitment process and better retention.
mktvkp_PlanCard4: It is part of the criteria used to make sure that performance evaluations and individual rewards are fair.
mktvkp_PlanCard5: It serves as the basis for talent development and career planning.
mktvkp_PlanCard6: It provides clear guidelines for manager-employee interaction around individual performance.
kurkvs_heading: How can you effectively develop your colleagues' competencies and skills?
kurkvs_headText: The characteristics of a modern methodology for introducing the competency model
kurkvs_content: Organizations typically decide to invest in the systematic development of competencies because they wish to improve the performance of their employees. The need to create an environment open to innovation and acceptance of new ideas, is on the other hand, probably even more important in today's world.  To improve its processes, introduce new or improved products and services to the market, as well as increase value for both the company and its customers, an organization must invest in innovative thinking. Innovative problem solving processes vary according to the complexity of the challenges, the extent to which the business environment must change, and the complexity of the stakeholders involved. Employees will need to learn new skills and abilities to innovate and create new products and services, and this requires the establishment of a competency model that will help them do so.
kurkvs_bulletLeftHeader: In order to get the most out of the competency model, we recommend that you take the following steps:
kurkvs_bullet1text: Competencies must be related to the organization's strategy and objectives.
kurkvs_bullet2text: Competences should be systematically and comprehensively integrated into other HRM processes.
kurkvs_bullet3text: Competencies alone have minimal impact, so they must be actively used for employee development.
kurkvs_bullet4text: In a well-functioning system, competences gradually become ingrained in employees' culture and thinking.
kurkvs_s1_imgHeading: Preparation of a sustainable development strategy
kurkvs_s1_imgDescription: The first step must undoubtedly be the creation of an effective development strategy. The following are the fundamental steps in establishing a development plan:
kurkvs_s1_item1Heading: 1. The identification of potential development areas
kurkvs_s1_item1Text: It is necessary to identify the work areas and work processes where negative consequences arise. This allows us to focus solely on specific focal points, reducing the time, effort, and resources required to build competencies.
kurkvs_s1_item2Text: The following phase is to identify the important stakeholders (managers, professional staff, young potential and talents, and successors) who are directly involved in the problematic areas. People who will be part of the development program are identified and, if necessary, tested before they can join.
kurkvs_s1_item3Heading: 3. Identifying and filling in the gaps
kurkvs_s1_item3Text: The domains of knowledge, skills, and personal potential are the primary areas in which we compare expected/desired and actual competence (i.e., where we are now and where we want to be) to determine where we stand. We recommend that you do a thorough DNLA evaluation of your employees' potential.
kurkvs_s1_item4BulletHeading: We set objectives at three levels:
kurkvs_s1_item4Text: Once the development objectives have been determined, we examine if they contribute to the achievement of the organization's strategic and operational goals. The development objectives must be redefined if they are not entirely aligned.
kurkvs_s2_subtext: Following the development strategy, the most appropriate methodology is chosen. Based on the gap identification and DNLA assessment results, we can precisely determine the competencies and development content that will have the greatest impact on critical staff development.

kurkvs_s2_item1Text: is the process of passing on knowledge through the use of a pre-planned program that is meant to help people learn, develop, and use the skills they need for a specific job or organization.
kurkvs_s2_item2Text: (individual or group) is a practice that aims to maximize an individual's potential in order to improve personal performance. Coaching is different from training because it doesn't involve lecturing. Instead, it gives the person who is being coached direction to help them reach their goals.

It is a highly effective way of introducing new processes and operational solutions, as well as for managing change within an organization. Additionally, this approach has a direct effect on organizational culture.

kurkvs_s2_item5Text: are a good way for people to share their knowledge, ideas, and best practices with each other while also focusing on how to solve problems.

kurkvs_s2_afterListText: When defining and selecting the proper methodology, it is important to consider the work techniques and procedures as well as the previously determined special needs of the participants, which are often missed when generic training and courses are conducted. In our experience, this is frequently the cause of a development's failure to produce the intended and expected results.
kpim_content: 360-degree feedback is one of the most commonly used approaches in modern human resource practice for identifying employee development needs. This evaluation technique is used when we want to evaluate an individual from different perspectives. The individual is assessed by himself, his supervisor, coworkers, and subordinates. The easiest and most effective way to get 360-degree feedback is to fill out an anonymous questionnaire.
kpim_topText: 360-degree feedback is most often used as a development tool. The analysis of the results provides objective information about how others perceive the employee. In this way, the person being evaluated receives comprehensive feedback on his or her strengths and personal challenges. The results must be looked at by qualified experts and, based on this, a qualitative interpretation should be given to the person being assessed. It is recommended to supplement the 360-degree feedback with other more individualized methods of development.
kpim_secondTextBottom: The report contains a graphical representation of the results according to the different evaluators and competencies.
kpim_listItem1: Those being evaluated are more likely to believe their ratings (the ratings are more credible).
kpim_listItem2: The manager is not the only one who evaluates a subordinate.
kpim_listItem3: Multiple perspectives negate individual judgmental errors.
kpim_listItem4: Anonymity ensures that the assessment is more accurate.
upijcprzp_heading: Effective 360-degree feedback is a comprehensive employee development approach that includes the 360-degree method of evaluation.
upijcprzp_imageDescription: Our solutions can help you manage the 360° evaluation process. This includes the creation of all parts of the process, as well as expert help with the formation and implementation of the whole process.
upijcprzp_item1Text: The success of 360-degree feedback is determined by the process's specific goal. To begin, create a clear communication plan that informs participants about the benefits and purpose of putting the process into action. To provide an efficient and consistent experience for all those involved in the process, the implementation program should be carefully prepared. Our program also includes training of the HR professionals and managers who are responsible for supervising and implementing the process.
upijcprzp_item2Text: The competency model should be designed in such a way that it serves as a firm foundation for staff development. As a result, the model must be constructed with the process's measurement system in mind. A special focus should be given to the competency rating scales that will be used to conduct the 360° assessment.
upijcprzp_item3Text: Managing and measuring of the 360-degree feedback process can be demanding. Managing the evaluators' participation and ensuring that the questionnaires are completed is a difficult task. This is something we can assist you with. We make the process easier by providing a high-quality technology evaluation solution. We can then help you thoroughly analyse the data and come up with a plan to deal with the problems you're having through the design of different types of training programs based on the assessments you took.
upijcprzp_item4Text: Participants must receive quality feedback and professional support for their personal development in order for the 360° feedback process to be truly effective. Accepting feedback and being motivated to change are essential for changing the behaviour of the specific individual. We can take care of these feedback meetings for you or we can teach your own employees how to give good feedback.
upijcprzp_item4BulletHeading: It is a customized process that includes:
upijcprzp_item4BulletText2: Developing a coaching plan for individual development.
upijcprzp_item4BulletText3: Receiving qualitative feedback from managers and co-workers.
upijcprzp_item4BulletText4: Providing comprehensive feedback based on reports and analysis.
upijcprzp_item4BulletText5: Analysing behaviours that require immediate change.
upijcprzp_item5Text: The 360° feedback process is only useful if it leads to concrete development actions. If you don't already have training programs in place, we can help you design and choose the best way to grow.
